title: A salary report

cases.name: three departments
cases.stdin:
ada,engineering,5200
linus,engineering,4800
grace,research,6100
bob,sales,3000
carol,sales,3500
dave,sales,2900

cases.name: departments come out in alphabetical order
salaries are compared as numbers, not as text

hints: Read all the input once: input="$(cat)", because you need it twice.
awk -F, '{ total[$2] += $3; count[$2]++ } END { for (d in total) print d, total[d], count[d] }' and then sort.
For the highest salary: sort -t, -k3 -n -r puts the largest first; head -n 1 takes it.
